sentences.text: Dame Enid Diana Elizabeth Rigg , DBE -LRB- born 20 July 1938 -RRB- is an English actress .	DBE	Order of the British Empire	Diana	Diana (US TV series)	Dame	Order of the British Empire

She is known for playing Emma Peel in the 1960s TV series The Avengers -LRB- 1965 -- 68 -RRB- , and Olenna Tyrell in Game of Thrones -LRB- 2013 -- present -RRB- .	Emma Peel	Emma Peel	The Avengers	The Avengers (TV series)	Olenna Tyrell	Olenna Tyrell	Game of Thrones	Game of Thrones

She has also had an extensive career in theatre , including playing the title role in Medea , both in London and New York , for which she won the 1994 Tony Award for Best Actress in a Play .	Actress	Actor	title role	Medea	Medea	Medea (play)	Tony Award	Tony Award	Best Actress in a Play	Tony Award for Best Actress in a Play
She was made a CBE in 1988 and a Dame in 1994 .	CBE	Order of the British Empire	Dame	Order of the British Empire

Rigg made her professional stage debut in 1957 in The Caucasian Chalk Circle , and joined the Royal Shakespeare Company in 1959 .	The Caucasian Chalk Circle	The Caucasian Chalk Circle	Royal Shakespeare Company	Royal Shakespeare Company
She made her Broadway debut in the 1971 production of Abelard & Heloise .	Broadway	Broadway (theatre)

Her film roles include Helena in A Midsummer Night 's Dream -LRB- 1968 -RRB- ; Countess Teresa di Vicenzo , wife of James Bond in On Her Majesty 's Secret Service -LRB- 1969 -RRB- ; Lady Holiday in The Great Muppet Caper -LRB- 1981 -RRB- ; and Arlene Marshall in Evil Under the Sun -LRB- 1982 -RRB- .	Teresa di Vicenzo	Tracy Bond	James Bond	James Bond	The Great Muppet Caper	The Great Muppet Caper	Evil Under the Sun	Evil Under the Sun (1982 film)
